notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Since we started the project we wanted to give players the choice of top down or free cam playstyles so everyone can play the way they want and this update is the result of that vision. You'll see in the main menu you can now choose your option.

We've also added difficulty options you'll find in the settings menu that let you choose what you are prepared to lose when you die, from everything to nothing, it's up to you!

We've overhauled the mission selection screen to a roguelike format where you need to complete missions to get to the final boss, fail and you keep your place but die and it resets to a new random selection of missions

We've also added tons of improvements to graphics and quality of life from more fluid menus to improved UI to new enemy models.

Looking forward to seeing what you think!

notes.title: Major demo update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=jiQU2v_IQxQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We've just released a major update for the demo with a combo of community feedback fixes and new content, we'd love to hear what you think. This is a relatively large change to the controls and camera but we feel it's a big improvement to gameplay, hopefully you'll agree but we'd love to hear what you think either way.

Features:
[list]
[*] New camera and controls
[*] Improved enemy AI
[*] Overhauled VFX
[*] Audio for many more features
[*] New post processing for day/evening/night
[*] Buttons for selling more items than 1 in a go
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] New controller support option in the pause menu (no more auto-switching!)
[*] Fixed profiles getting locked out of game when selling certain weapons
[*] Fixed collision in many areas on the map, not more invisible walls!
[*] Changed bug report form to go straight to form to fix in-game issues reporting
[/list]

This is the first of many updates but we'd love to hear what you think and please do let us know in the community tab
